newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X may face lawsuit over Busang.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X may face lawsuit over Busang.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd said Friday that an Indonesian partner in its huge Busang gold deposit may file a lawsuit in Alberta against Bre-X and 19 others over an ownership dispute.
Bre-X said it had received a letter from Canadian lawyers for PT Krueng Gasui, one of Bre-X's partners in Indonesia which is claiming up to 40 percent of the rich gold discovery.

Bre-X reported that the letter said Krueng Gasui would take legal action against Bre-X, certain Indonesian partners of Bre-X, Bre-X officers and Minorca Resources Inc unless the dispute is resolved soon.
The letter demands a meeting to resolve the dispute with Bre-X, Krueng Gasui and lawyers for both sides on or before November 22, Bre-X said.

The letter states that if "Bre-X refuses to attend such a meeting or if meaningful discussions to resolve the dispute do not take place at that meeting, (Krueng Gasui lawyers) are instructed to file and serve a statement of claim," Bre-X said in a statement.
The claim would request damanges of about US$1.9 billion, substantial punitive damages and other remedies.
Bre-X said it has told its lawyers to arrange a meeting with Krueng Gasui's lawyers in Canada.
Bre-X said Krueng Gasui has so far failed to provide Bre-X with documents to support its claims.

"I find it curious that PT Krueng Gasui has chosen to threaten a lwsuit in Canada relating to matters that allegedly occurred in Indonesia," Bre-X president David Walsh said in a statement. "However, we will sit down with them and listen to what they have to say."
